name: AfriSenti-SemEval 2023: African Sentiment Analysis Benchmark
description: AfriSenti-SemEval 2023 (SemEval-2023 Task 12) is a multilingual sentiment analysis benchmark covering 14 African languages across 4 distinct language families: Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, Amharic, Algerian Arabic, Moroccan Arabic, Swahili, Kinyarwanda, Twi, Mozambican Portuguese, Oromo, Tigrinya, and Xitsonga. Collected from Twitter/X and annotated by native speakers into positive, negative, and neutral sentiments, the benchmark comprises 111,718 tweets partitioned into 63,685 train, 13,726 dev, and 34,307 test examples across monolingual, multilingual, and zero-shot evaluation tracks.
